sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234474 (public search API, 23 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: '22 rentable sites with 13 of them being reservable and 9 for our walk-up visitors'; the Forest Service calls it a '23-site campground' and the catalog lists 23. All back-in; the catalog gives no usable lengths (0 on most sites, 42 and 49 ft on two).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234474 (Overview) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234474 (Driveway Entry Back-In on all 23) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lid-creek-campground ('a 23-site campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No drinking water; the nearest is at Lost Johnny Point Campground about 5 miles north. Host on site. Native (unsurfaced) boat ramp, small craft only.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lid-creek-campground ('picnic tables, vault toilets, & fire grates. There is no water available. There is a native boat ramp- only small watercraft are recommended', 'Water can be found at the Lost Johnny Point Campground, which is located about 5 miles north') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234474 (amenity 'Host'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Fee covers one vehicle; a second is $5/night. The Forest Service page (last updated April 2025) still says $16.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234474/rates (2026-2028 peak seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $18) + recreation.gov notice ('the first vehicle is included in the site fee and an extra vehicle charge of $5.00/vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run in summer by the concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. 13 sites reservable on recreation.gov until 4 days before arrival, 9 walk-up. 16 consecutive nights, 32 a year. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234474 (Overview '13 of them being reservable and 9 for our walk-up visitors. The stay limit is 16 consecutive nights'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 each year, reservationCutOff 4) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lid-creek-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead National Forest on the west shore of Hungry Horse Reservoir, 15 mi south of Hungry Horse, in mixed conifers; sites listed 21-60 ft. Access via the narrow, switchbacked West Side Reservoir Road (not suited to very large rigs). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 22 sites (13 reservable on recreation.gov, 9 walk-up), vault toilets, no drinking water, $18/night (2026 rate table), phone (concessionaire). Added season (mid May - September), 16-night limit, 4-day cutoff, Flathead Valley Campgrounds concession. Not stated: max rig length (catalog lengths mostly 0), booking window (left inherited). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Access caveat: recreation.gov says 'The West Side Reservoir Road is narrow with many switchbacks. Not suitable for larger RV's.' (paved per directions). Probably fine for a 23-ft motorhome, but a human may want to judge.
Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov says the campground 'lies on the Hungry Horse Reservoir' and the Forest Service puts it 'on the west shore'; the entry is 'lakeview'.
The Forest Service page's $16 single-site fee is stale (page last updated April 2025); recreation.gov's 2026 rate is $18, which stands.
